title: Updating Career Guidance Counsellors for Students on Industry Trends
what_it_is: Updating Career Guidance Counsellors for Students on Industry Trends

sections.label: ECG Counsellors Guidance Resources
sections.summary: ECG Counsellors are guided by Industry Transformation Maps, Skills Frameworks and agency publications, and MOE, SSG and WSG developed the MySkillsFuture portal.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Education (Ms Low Yen Ling) (for the Minister for Education (Schools))
sentences.text: ECG Counsellors are also guided by the respective Industry Transformation Maps (ITMs) and Skills Frameworks, as well as publications by agencies that help them stay up-to-date with the emerging trends, career pathways and kind of skills in demand by various industries.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Education (Ms Low Yen Ling) (for the Minister for Education (Schools))
sentences.text: MOE, SkillsFuture Singapore (SSG) and Workforce Singapore (WSG) have also developed MySkillsFuture, a one-stop ECG portal for both students and working adults.

sections.label: IHLs Support Student Workplace Transition
sections.summary: Institutes of Higher Learning partner SSG, WSG and e2i and organise industry talks, pre-employment workshops and career fairs to support students entering the workplace.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Education (Ms Low Yen Ling) (for the Minister for Education (Schools))
sentences.text: Furthermore, the Institutes of Higher Learning partner SSG, WSG and e2i to support students as they transit into the workplace.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Education (Ms Low Yen Ling) (for the Minister for Education (Schools))
sentences.text: They regularly organise events, such as industry talks, pre-employment workshops and career fairs, to deepen the students' understanding of industry and career opportunities, as well as develop their job-seeking skills.

sections.label: Counsellor Training and Networking Sessions
sections.summary: Counsellors receive professional training on education and career counselling and stay updated through networking and sharing sessions with WSG and e2i career coaches.

sentences.speaker: Ms Low Yen Ling
sentences.text: When they join us, they are given professional training on education and career counselling.

sentences.speaker: Ms Low Yen Ling
sentences.text: Even after they have joined us, we make sure that they stay updated through regular networking and sharing sessions with career coaches from WSG and e2i.

sections.label: Exposure Through Lateral Postings
sections.summary: Counsellors receive exposure and development through lateral postings across schools and other PSEIs.

sentences.speaker: Ms Low Yen Ling
sentences.text: As they perform in their job, we will ensure that they receive exposure and development through lateral postings across schools as well as other PSEIs.

sections.label: Sessions Organised Over Two Years
sections.summary: Over the last two years, more than 24 of such sessions have been organised.

sentences.speaker: Ms Low Yen Ling
sentences.text: Over the last two years, we have organised more than 24 of such sessions.
